scope: The recorded checkpoint5 browser ran six full native people, actual source materials, requested hair and original complete shoes. It predates the current dynamic shoe/garment integration and later motion improvements. Startup is not final action or performance acceptance.

independentRootReview.street: Clear cream/green courtyard layout, accessible visible controls and complete six-person scene; overview leaves room around the full block. Follow-camera images show each full person without building occlusion.
independentRootReview.nativeAppearance: All six heads, faces, requested male short/buzz and female medium/long original hair, clothes and shoes render. Directional shoe shape no longer shows the prior excessive back-opening flare.
remainingVisualDefects: Old NativeWardrobe: E light trousers show through the lower dark top; F top side approaches/intersects the arm. New garment corrective is not integrated in this checkpoint.
Female original pulled-back hair forms two broad front bundles; original static shape and dynamic shoulder/garment collision remain unreviewed.
Action visuals, actual integrated dynamic clothing/shoes, full chain, offline and public URL remain to be reviewed.
independentRootReview.performance: Actual CI uses SwiftShader. Cold ready 372.585 s; completed full-raster frame times include 15.77–68.71 s. This is evidence of software-renderer cost, not a measured hardware/user-device frame rate or a performance pass.
